label: Workforce Overview & Support Provisioning
permission_expression: // This screen exposes only the workforce-overview widget and SUPPORT provisioning. return hasAny('workforce.dashboard.view', 'workforce.user.create');

label: Role Governance
permission_expression: { const canManageFinance = roles.includes('SUPER_ADMIN') && hasAny('workforce.role.assign', 'workforce.role.revoke'); const canManageOperational = (roles.includes('ADMINISTRATOR') || roles.includes('SUPER_ADMIN')) && hasAny('workforce.role.assign_operational', 'workforce.role.revoke_operational'); return canManageFinance || canManageOperational;

label: Privileged Approvals
permission_expression: // The implemented approval actions are assigned to FINANCE_CONTROLLER by the existing // maker-checker rules, and the approval service also checks privileged:approve. return roles.includes('FINANCE_CONTROLLER') && has('privileged:approve');

label: SMS & Email Notifications
permission_expression: // INTEGRATION (Phase 5): server read contract (Arena 1 registry requireRead) accepts // notification.view_deliveries OR a FINANCE_CONTROLLER checker (MFA verified per // request) — checkers must be able to open the console to inspect frozen proposals // before approving/executing them. if (roles.includes('FINANCE_CONTROLLER') && has('privileged:approve')) return true; return hasAny( 'notification.view_deliveries', 'notification.view_events', 'notification.view_templates', 'notification.manage_templates', 'notification.approve_templates', 'notification.manage_configuration', 'notification.approve_configuration', 'notification.view_provider_status', 'notification.test_send', );
